brief: Every arrival in this town ends in a stop that performs something and usually says it - there are 37 sayAt sites. One does not. #147 counted 101 allotment kneels a year (3 seeds, probes/allot-year.mjs): 71 harvests, 15 turns and 15 hand-sows, and the hand-sows plant ZERO cells, because a kneel only ever reaches an UNRIPE plot and by then caTick's infill has already sown every cell of it. A holder comes in through the gate, kneels, plants nothing, says nothing, and walks out. Give that visit a real act at an unripe plot - watering from the butt, thinning, weeding, staking, propping a cloche - chosen from what the plot's own state and its ALLOT_FURN actually afford, with its own ticker line. Re-count the 15-of-101 on HEAD before you build: it is #147's number from three seeds and it is the whole premise.
successLooksLike: Over a year x 3 seeds, zero kneels perform nothing; the act is legible in an allotment crop at the plot's own scale; the ticker names it when you are looking at the allotments.
avoid: Do not add a plot state or a species - the plots are monoculture BY CONSTRUCTION (#147, 0 of 69,008 sown plot-samples held two species) and this brief is about what the PERSON does, not what grows. Prefer hash(plot, k) to a new R() draw: any new draw reshuffles the whole seeded world and the census will churn everywhere. If the re-count on HEAD refutes the 15-of-101, say so and reject the brief - that is a good outcome, not a failure.
